approvers: Owner/director decides; site manager recommends; glazing subcontractor and insurer may weigh in
reason: We already protect frames with the factory film plus our own film and board at about 12 euro per m2, and this is around 19. For a glazing-damage problem that is small per block I cannot show my owner why we should pay more, with no Maltese reference job.
objection: It costs more than what we do now, the aluminium already comes with factory film, and I do not want to be the one who recommended a coating that marks the glass or does not peel cleanly at handover.
instead: Keep using factory film, self-adhesive film and board with tape applied by our own labour, and keep the existing snagging and claim routes with the glazing subcontractor.
would_change_my_mind: A Maltese block finished with it, with documented before-and-after damage figures and the coating maker's written compatibility confirmation for our glass and frame finish, at a price close to what we pay today.
